scope: host ASan/UBSan execution of pure upstream helper tests; no QEMU, MMIO, real UFS or enuma boot
compiler:
Ubuntu clang version 14.0.0-1ubuntu1.1
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

tests.name: RootPublication
tests.stdout: PASS: complete preparation or rollback, dispatch failure, SystemOS first/OS last, every start/media failure, no future publication, retained started devices, bounded valid ancestry
